name: Jasper
description: Jasper is an AI platform purpose-built for marketing teams that orchestrates specialized AI agents to execute end-to-end marketing workflows, combining content generation with brand governance and enterprise-scale automation.

features: 100+ specialized marketing AI agents (SEO, campaigns, email, social, translation)
Brand Voice / Style Guides / Visual Guidelines governance
Content Pipelines (Canvas, Grid, AI Studio) for repeatable workflows
